text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs by reading error messages carefully and testing small parts of your program. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you see exactly what happens inside your code. A systematic approach is important: change one thing at a time and check the result before moving on. Logging is also very useful, because well-placed log messages show what your program was doing before it failed. By combining these strategies, you can find and fix problems faster and become a more confident developer.
